SELECT p.id, p.url, p.thumbnailUrl, p.name, p.category, p.tags, p.picSize, p.picWidth, p.picHeight, p.picScale, p.picFormat, p.mainColor, p.colorFamily, p.downloadCount, p.collectCount, p.userId, p.spaceId, p.createTime FROM collect c JOIN picture p ON p.id = c.pictureId WHERE c.userId = #{userId} AND p.isDelete = 0 AND ( (p.spaceId IS NULL AND p.reviewStatus = 1)
OR p.spaceId IS NOT NULL
OR (p.spaceId IS NOT NULL AND p.spaceId IN (SELECT su.spaceId FROM space_user su WHERE su.userId = #{userId}))
) ORDER BY c.createTime DESC, c.id DESC
